latestVersion.changelog:
AI-powered video editing for Android — quickly edit and export videos on mobile:

- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), describe desired edits, and receive a 1080p MP4 ready to download.
- Fast, cloud-based rendering (usually 1–2 minutes per short clip); nothing to install.
- Simple natural language commands for trimming, transitions, background music, text overlays, and more.
- Full session management with free usage tier (100 credits, 7 days).
- Integrated file upload, export, and real-time status updates, with automatic handling of credits and errors.
- Designed for Android creators and mobile-first workflows, skipping complex editor interfaces entirely.
